Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.skin

package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.skin
Skin resolution: naming a skin, fetching it, and plugging in another place to fetch it from.

SkinSource names one, SkinService resolves it into a NpcSkin, and SkinProvider is the extension point for a server with its own skin database.
